_about: Base 16 / Gripper 23 miniature branch from Base 15 / Gripper 22: same captured axle/cap and involute gear method, purpose-designed narrow jaws and frame. No scaling of servo or fasteners. All dimensions in mm. Resin/machined light-load prototype; not a drop-in full-size handle interface.

params.label: Servo w
params.doc: Narrowest case dimension from STS3215 STEP in Base 15.

params.name: servo_len

params.doc: Case length, same measured STEP.
